what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to appoint Brian Lafond to the vacant Board of Assessors seat, with the term running to the May 2024 election.
The appointment followed an interview in a remote joint session with the Board of Assessors' one sitting member, who spoke in favor along with Select Board members.
The caption of the roll call is garbled, but it ends with unanimous support from members present.
A quorum of assessors now exists, so the appointee may begin scheduling meetings, though the oath of office is to wait for another candidate.
Assessors tentatively plan to move their meetings to Wednesday evenings, 6:30 to 8:30.

why_it_matters: The Board of Assessors sets property valuations that feed into tax bills, and it had one sitting member, so this appointment restores a quorum to the board that does that work.
The seat is filled only until the May 2024 election, so residents will be asked to vote on it then.
watch_next: Swearing in of the new assessor, which the discussion tied to the arrival of another candidate.
The May 2024 election, when the seat goes to a vote.
